summary: Full backend + frontend verification of Tidhkar prayer-reminder Expo app. 8/8 backend pytest cases pass (prayer-times happy path + 422 validations + mongo cache; adhkar list; audio 404 + salawat WAV with RIFF header validated). Frontend mobile viewport (390x844) smoke covers all requested testIDs: home-screen renders with ticking next-prayer-countdown, 6 prayer rows, next-dhikr-card, location-banner; adhkar-screen renders 6 dhikr cards (salawat/tahlil/tasbih/hamd/takbir/istighfar) with toggles + play (label flips to إيقاف when playing); disabling all 6 toggles reveals adhkar-empty and header count goes 6→0; settings-screen master switch, interval chips 15/30/60, adhan switch, and settings-test-reminder all work and display app-toast; interval selection propagates to adhkar header subtitle and next-dhikr-time on home; settings persist across page reload (verified interval=60). No red screens, no page errors. Deprecated packages detected: none in dependencies (uses expo-audio, no expo-av).

issues: Non-blocking RN Web warnings: 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use boxShadow); props.pointerEvents deprecated (use style.pointerEvents). Cosmetic only — safe to defer, but main agent may want to migrate shadow styles for forward-compat.

action_items: (Optional) Replace deprecated shadow* style props with boxShadow across styled components to clear RN Web console warnings.
(Optional) Replace deprecated props.pointerEvents with style.pointerEvents where used.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend uses EMERGENT_LLM_KEY and tts_service correctly; audio endpoint lazy-generates and caches WAV on disk — works and returns valid RIFF.
Prayer-times validates date pattern dd-mm-yyyy via Query regex and lat/lng bounds; invalid returns 422 as expected.
Backend excludes MongoDB _id via BaseDocument.to_mongo (pop _id); no ObjectId leakage observed.
Frontend reads BACKEND URL via EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (Expo convention) — note system prompt references EXPO_BACKEND_URL; tests fall back correctly.
seed_data_creation: None — tests write to prayer_cache collection with keys prefixed by rounded lat/lng/date; safe idempotent inserts.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL in frontend/.env is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. All testIDs listed in review_request are implemented and functioning. Tab testIDs tab-home/tab-adhkar/tab-settings are available. Toast testID is app-toast.
